title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer. We would like to agree a longer-term price basis for the full annual volume of 94,800 kg, and the attached packages offer a 24-month or 36-month commitment.

The surcharge series has fallen: idx:AS-14404@2026-06 at 3182.6744 dropped to idx:AS-14404@2026-09 at 3007.8019, a change of -5.49%.
The processing index has also fallen: idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05 at 131.9 dropped to idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08 at 129.1, a change of -2.12%.

Your letter of July also confirms that your alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027.

Could you tell us which package suits you best? Are there cheaper variants, such as other bar lengths or tolerances?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We welcome the prospect of a 24-month agreement; however, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot maintain fixed pricing for this duration. While we acknowledge the slight decrease in PPI-C2431, our alloy costs are fixed until March 2027, meaning the recent drop in AS-14404 does not reduce our current cost base.

Our primary proposal provides a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.46 per unit, for a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our technical department will contact you separately to discuss whether alternative bar lengths or tolerances might offer cost advantages.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 - index clause with deadband, 24/36-month packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer. We accept the principle of an AS-14404 clause. The attached packages include one, with a deadband.

Your letter of July says your nickel and alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027. Market movements therefore do not reach your costs until then, whether the index rises or falls. A clause running from the August 2026 base month without a deadband would pass on changes you do not bear. A deadband makes the clause fair to both sides. We also offer the longer term as an option.

Your owner offered in April to walk us through your calculation. Could we use that in an authorized pricing review? Are there cheaper bar lengths or tolerances?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - index clause with deadband, 24/36-month packages
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause and can offer a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

While we decline a detailed cost breakdown or pricing review, our pricing accurately reflects our fixed alloy costs until March 2027. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Regarding alternative bar lengths or tolerances, please share your exact specifications so our technical team can assess potential options.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised packages with AS-14404 clause and 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the variant savings. We will review the grade and tolerance options with engineering.

You asked for our data. Your scorecard sc:70710@2026Q3 shows 75 ppm, above your standard commitment of 50 ppm. The same scorecard sc:70710@2026Q3 records on-time delivery of 88%.

All attached packages keep your AS-14404 clause and 90 days payment. Each covers 94,800 kg per year. We now offer a 36-month term, which gives you three years of planned volume. The deadband options reflect your fixed alloy coverage until March 2027.

Which package could you make your primary standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised packages with AS-14404 clause and 36-month option
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We have reviewed the scorecard data you provided; while we take our quality and delivery targets seriously, this does not alter our calculation.
We welcome your proposal of a 36-month contract term, as it offers valuable planning security for both parties.
In exchange for this extended commitment, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.35 per unit for the package with a standard AS-14404 clause.
Our current defect rate for you is about 50 ppm.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.
